summary: First full test run of Viaura HOUSE. Wrote pytest backend suite (27 tests) covering catalog, offer zone, combos, categories, settings, cart validation with coupons (valid/invalid/min-order), guest order + mock payment flow, stock decrement, out-of-stock protection, order tracking (email/mobile/wrong contact), webhook idempotency, register/login/me/logout, admin RBAC (anon+customer rejected), admin dashboard, product/coupon/combo CRUD, order status flow + shipping, and settings propagation. ALL 27 backend tests PASS (100%). Frontend Playwright walked home → category → product detail → cart+coupon → checkout → admin login → admin dashboard/products/orders. Found ONE HIGH-priority frontend bug: guest checkout `Pay & Place Order` never reaches the order-success page — after mock payment succeeds server-side (order IS created, verified & marked PAID in DB), the SPA redirects the user to /cart instead of /order-success/{order_number}.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful order + mock payment verification, user is redirected to /cart instead of /order-success/{order_number}. Root cause: placeOrder() calls clearCart() before nav('/order-success/...'). The useEffect on line 34 watches [items.length] and calls nav('/cart') the moment items becomes empty, racing/overriding the success navigation. Backend order + payment DID succeed (verified via admin orders list — order JH202600006 appears as Paid). User just never lands on success screen and cart appears empty with no confirmation, breaking the entire purchase UX.

integration_issues.issue: OrderSuccess page never rendered in Playwright run because of the /cart redirect described above. Track Order page (/track) itself works: inputs `track-order-input`, `track-contact-input`, `track-submit` are all present and wired correctly (verified backend endpoint returns proper timeline).

action_items: FIX CheckoutPage.jsx placeOrder: swap the order to `nav('/order-success/'+order.order_number); clearCart();` (nav first so component unmounts before items.length effect can fire), OR gate the items.length===0 redirect with a `submitted`/`busy` flag so it does not fire after successful payment. Same fix needed in the Razorpay handler success branch (line 82-83).
Optional: after fix, verify /order-success/{orderNumber} page renders and 'Track this order' CTA works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutPage.jsx: `useEffect(() => { if (items.length === 0) nav('/cart'); }, [items.length])` races with clearCart()+nav('/order-success') on success — must guard with a submitted flag or navigate before clearing cart. This is the highest priority issue.

auth_routes.py login: brute-force lockout window is set/updated on EACH failed attempt (`$set locked_until`), so every new failed attempt extends the lock — the counter never resets naturally, only manually deleted after a successful login. Consider using $setOnInsert for locked_until or basing lockout only when count crosses threshold. Minor.

commerce_routes.py webhook: when RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty, signature verification is skipped entirely — safe in mock mode but must be enforced once live keys are set. Consider requiring the secret in production mode.
catalog_routes.py add_review: model ReviewInput includes product_id but the route also has it as path param — the two must match; not currently validated. Minor.

commerce_routes.py `_apply_coupon` for create_order path is NOT wrapped in try/except, so an invalid/expired coupon at order time returns 400 (correct), but the coupon_error semantics differ from /cart/validate. Consistent behavior — OK.
server.py deprecated `@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown')` — should migrate to lifespan context manager in FastAPI 0.109+. Non-blocking.

After main agent fixes CheckoutPage checkout→success redirect, re-run the frontend Playwright to confirm order-success page renders and Track flow completes end-to-end. Route reminder: category routes are /women /kids /gifts /offer-zone /trending (NOT /shop/women), track page is /track (NOT /track-order).
rca of the issue: CheckoutPage.jsx placeOrder() lines 57-60 (mock branch) and 82-83 (razorpay branch) call clearCart() BEFORE nav('/order-success/...'). Because CartContext's items state updates synchronously via React state, on next render the useEffect on line 34-37 [`if (items.length === 0) nav('/cart')`] fires and overrides the pending order-success navigation with a /cart redirect. Reproduction: Add any item → /checkout → fill valid details → click Pay & Place Order → observe URL becomes /cart instead of /order-success/JH2026xxxxx (backend order + payment DID succeed as verified via GET /api/admin/orders). Mitigation: (a) swap order → call nav('/order-success/'+order.order_number) BEFORE clearCart(), OR (b) introduce a `submitted` state set to true before nav and gate the empty-cart redirect with `!submitted && items.length===0`.
